主题游戏乐园
我来玩数字
主题说说
生活中，随处都可以玩数字游戏，孩子如果能在游戏中学会认数字、数数，这种认知体验对他来说是很美好的。孩子从背数字，到能点数，再到对应上相应的阿拉伯数字，需要一个阶段，希望每个孩子都能带着兴趣，快乐地度过这个阶段。
宝贝这样玩
小朋友，请按照虚线，把右页上面的所有图片都剪下来。现在，和爸爸妈妈一起，用这些图片在“宝贝作品展”的页面上玩个游戏吧。看，那里有10个篮子，每个篮子上都有数字编号。小朋友，请把剪下来的图片，按照类别分好，青蛙是一组，小鸟是一组……总共有10组。现在，数一数它们各有多少个，请给它们找到合适的数字篮子，放进去吧。
剪下后，将此图分贴到反斗，效果更好哦

page_text_en:
Theme Game Park
I'll Play with Numbers
Theme Explanation
In daily life, you can play number games anywhere. It's a wonderful cognitive experience for children to learn to recognize numbers and count through play. From memorizing numbers to being able to count them, and then matching them with corresponding Arabic numerals, this process takes time. We hope every child can go through this stage with interest and joy.
How to Play,宝贝
Dear child, please cut out all the pictures on the right page along the dotted lines. Now, play a game with your parents using these pictures on the "Children's Art Exhibition" page. Look, there are 10 baskets there, each with a number. Please sort the cut-out pictures by category—frogs as one group, birds as another... there are 10 groups in total. Now, count how many there are in each group, and put them into the matching numbered baskets.
After cutting, stick this page onto the back of the other page for better results.
Please cut along the dotted lines.
